title: This Wasp Builds a Clay Jar, Then Seals a Living Caterpillar Inside
subject: potter wasp

scenes.text: This wasp makes pottery. And the jar has a living victim inside.
The female mixes mud with water and her own saliva into little balls.
She builds them into a small clay pot, one brood cell at a time.
Then she hunts caterpillars and paralyzes them, so they stay alive but can't move.
She lays an egg in the pot. Some species hang it from a thread.
Then she closes the jar with a mud cap. Her baby wakes up to fresh food.

description:
Potter wasps build clay pots, stock them with paralyzed caterpillars and seal them with a mud cap.
The hatching larva eats its fresh meal.
Have you ever found a wasp nest?
first_comment: Would you rather be a potter wasp or its caterpillar? Which insect builds the best home?
